title: Floating chat
responsibility: Keeps a round chat bubble visible and opens a compact conversation with keyboard focus and Escape support.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.open
inputs.description: The bindable flag controls whether the panel is visible. It defaults to false; after the first opening, closing hides the panel while keeping its contents mounted.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.label
inputs.description: Sets the accessible name on the launcher button. The component uses the string as provided and does not validate or alter it.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.panelLabel
inputs.description: Sets the accessible name on the conversation panel when it is mounted. The component uses the string as provided and does not validate or alter it.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.title
inputs.description: Text shown as the panel heading whenever the panel is mounted. It is rendered as an h2 and is not used as the panel's accessible name.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.notice
inputs.description: Optional explanatory text below the title; an empty string omits both the paragraph and its aria-describedby reference. It defaults to an empty string.
examples: Ask a question, plan a design, or request a code change.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.navigation
inputs.description: Optional Svelte snippet rendered between the header and scrolling conversation body. When omitted, it is undefined and nothing is rendered in that slot.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.follow
inputs.description: Controls automatic scrolling and defaults to true. When true, opening reveals the end and content mutations do so only if the reader is within 32 pixels of the bottom; when false, opening starts at the top and mutations do not auto-scroll.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.children
inputs.description: Required Svelte snippet rendered inside the scrollable conversation body. Its contents are supplied by the caller, and the component observes body mutations for its follow behavior.

outputs.name: FloatingChat
outputs.description: Renders a fixed 54-pixel launcher and a floating conversation panel, which mounts on first open and is hidden after closing. The panel is at most 400 pixels wide and 620 pixels tall subject to viewport constraints; opening focuses an enabled visible textarea when present (otherwise the panel), Escape closes it for events inside the component, and closing returns focus to the launcher.

errors.name: snippet error
errors.description: If the caller-provided children or navigation snippet throws while Svelte renders it, that error propagates; this component does not catch or transform it.
